visual.description: Full-viewport-width hero image with a thin sticky navigation bar above containing logo centered, search left, account/cart right, and a secondary full-width category nav below it.
Eight product category cards arranged in two rows of four equal-width columns, each card showing an image above and a capitalized label below.
Two equal-width editorial video/image panels side by side, both dark-toned cinematic stills filling their cells completely with no visible gap hierarchy.
Two more equal-width editorial video panels side by side continuing the same dark cinematic visual rhythm as the section above.
Footer link columns split into four equal-width groups (Services, Orders, La Maison Hermès, Legal) with uppercase bold headings and regular-weight links below.
Bottom footer bar with customer service info left-aligned, newsletter subscription centered, and social follow icons right-aligned in a three-part horizontal layout.
